finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 but spec requires 10 (uses > instead of >=).
2) parse_coupon is case‑sensitive; codes like "save20" or "SaVe50" raise ValueError though spec allows any capitalization.
3) Cart.remove_item leaves an item with quantity 0 in the cart; spec says items should be removed when remaining quantity <=0.
4) Cart.total adds shipping_fee based on the original subtotal instead of the discounted amount after applying a coupon, violating the spec that says shipping is calculated from the post‑coupon subtotal.
